supersedes: Stage1_1813_90_Robust_20260915/run_01 (invalid: reused user's discarded experimental porosity variability)
user_experimental_variability_note: All prior user experimental results (first paper, ID-80/ID-90 specimens, replicate SDs) are deliberately excluded by study design. No numerical value in this contract is derived from them.

achieved_porosity.source_citation: Rounded, conservative literature-informed prior. Order-of-magnitude support: Crouch et al. (ASTM STP, 2012) repeated pervious-concrete fresh-void testing, void-content CVs ~1.1-3.6% across mixes (sub-1pp scatter at ~20-25% void levels, not several pp); external controlled-compaction studies (e.g. Mitrosz et al., Sci Rep 2025) showing porosity sensitivity to vibration/compaction of order fractions of a pp per unit change in compaction condition.
achieved_porosity.source_status_note: NOT a measured project-specific or published universal batch-to-batch SD. No defensible universal published batch-to-batch SD for hardened pervious-concrete porosity exists; 1.0pp is a rounded engineering prior constructed conservatively from external evidence only.
achieved_porosity.double_counting_notes: Represents residual achieved-porosity uncertainty from unresolved placement/compaction/material-state effects. Do NOT add a second independent compaction random variable or porosity-measurement-error term on top of this in the baseline run (Sections E7/E8).

cement_mass.source_citation: Conservative process envelope informed by concrete batching-scale accuracy guidance (NRMCA/ASTM C94-class scale-accuracy criteria); not itself a standard-prescribed stochastic SD.
cement_mass.double_counting_notes: w/c is always DERIVED from perturbed C_actual and W_actual; never sampled independently.

added_water.form: W_nominal = wc_nominal * C_nominal; W_actual = W_nominal * (1 + delta_W)
added_water.source_citation: Conservative process envelope informed by water-meter/batching accuracy guidance.
added_water.double_counting_notes: wc_actual = W_actual / C_actual recomputed AFTER cement and water perturbation; w/c is never independently randomized. Residual aggregate free-moisture impact is folded into the wide (+/-3%) sensitivity scenario rather than given its own baseline distribution -- no repeated project moisture data exist (data gap; recommend ASTM C566/C127-style measurement before physical batching).

aggregate_bin_masses.form: A_i_actual = A_i_nominal * (1 + delta_Ai), per separately batched bin; A_CA_actual = sum_i A_i_actual; g_i_actual = A_i_actual / A_CA_actual
aggregate_bin_masses.source_citation: Conservative process envelope informed by aggregate-scale weighing accuracy guidance.
aggregate_bin_masses.double_counting_notes: Realised gradation fractions are DERIVED from perturbed bin masses; no second independent fraction noise is added on top (would double count weighing error and can violate simplex closure).

sand_mass.form: S_actual = S_nominal * (1 + delta_S) if S_nominal > 0 else 0
sand_mass.double_counting_notes: If nominal sand is exactly 0, S_actual is held EXACTLY 0 (no noise-created material).

superplasticizer.form: SP_actual = SP_nominal * (1 + delta_SP) if SP_nominal > 0 else 0
superplasticizer.source_citation: Conservative process envelope informed by admixture-dispenser accuracy guidance.
superplasticizer.double_counting_notes: If nominal SP == 0, SP_actual is held EXACTLY 0 in every scenario draw.

gradation_stockpile_mode_B.form: logistic-normal in ALR coordinates, sensitivity-only fallback ~1pp SD per major fraction capped ~3pp (stress ~2pp capped ~5pp), closure preserved
gradation_stockpile_mode_B.source_citation: Numerical fallback envelope, not fitted to repeated project sieve data.
gradation_stockpile_mode_B.double_counting_notes: Not used for the primary 90% reliability claim; mode A (bin-mass-derived) is the active baseline.

compaction.form: no independent compaction random variable in baseline; represented through achieved_porosity
compaction.source_citation: No validated mapping from compaction effort to model inputs exists for this project.
compaction.double_counting_notes: Introducing a second independent compaction variable alongside the full achieved-porosity term would double count the same physical mechanism (Section E7).

porosity_measurement_error.form: observation-layer only; NOT added to latent true porosity used in the manufacturing reliability calculation
porosity_measurement_error.source_citation: Reserved for future laboratory validation planning (Section E8).
porosity_measurement_error.double_counting_notes: Must not be double-counted into the robust search; discussed only, never sampled here.

strength_permeability_measurement_error.form: additional optimiser noise = 0 when paired predictive-residual sampling is active
strength_permeability_measurement_error.source_citation: Paired study-held-out residuals already combine modelling, between-study and observation variability.
strength_permeability_measurement_error.double_counting_notes: Adding a separate generic measurement CV on top of the paired residual distribution would double count.

correlations.baseline: all manufacturing perturbations independent EXCEPT physically-derived relationships (w/c derived from C,W; total CA and gradation derived from bin masses; zero-dose components stay exactly zero)
correlations.limitation: No fitted project-specific batching/process correlation matrix exists; real correlations may be present and are not modelled here.

reliability_mode_notes: Signed paired residuals resampled directly from tables/paired_residual_bank.csv (see PAIRED_RESIDUAL_BANK_AUDIT.md). The historical q90 lower-bound screen is retained ONLY as a diagnostic/reference column, never combined multiplicatively with manufacturing pass rate, and never applied inside the same scenario as a paired residual draw (that would double-count predictive/model error).
